_comment: CAP-18 changelog. DATA, not markup — so it can be rendered in-app,
localised, and reused verbatim in store release notes rather than being
retyped. The legacy app had this inline in a template.
`version` must match package.json; `entries` are newest first. Each change
is a plain sentence with no formatting, so a renderer never has to parse
anything. `kind` groups them for display and is a stable identifier.

changes.text: A complete rebuild of Vocab Cards for phone, tablet and web.
Spelling feedback now marks swapped letters as one mistake instead of two, and shows a missing space instead of hiding it.
A trophies screen. All 24 trophies have existed since 2017, but there was never a way to see them.
Results after every test, with the words you missed and a one-tap way to drill just those.
Settings that actually do something: exact-case marking, quick-test size, which side shows first, and appearance.
Export your whole library to a single file, and bring it back on another device.
Your existing card sets and trophy progress come across automatically. Nothing is removed from your old library.
Importing several .cards files at once now imports all of them. Previously only the first was read.
Creating a set with a name you already use no longer replaces the old set without asking.
Starting a test on an empty set no longer leaves the app on a blank screen.
Card text is never treated as markup, closing a security hole in the old web app.
Text now grows when you raise your device's font size.
